content.text: – trying suppression for that as well.
suppressions dont appear needed anymore - resteing more widly (tried on ubuntu 1910).
oh - I see what changed. It was failing in call from curl (and maybe is didnt test that) - but is now failing when I use add provider stuff for new openssl3.

- fails on Ubuntu 18.04 and 21.10, valgrind -q --gen-suppressions=yes --tool=helgrind --suppressions=Tests/Valgrind-Helgrind-Common.supp  Builds/valgrind-release-SSLPurify-NoBlockAlloc/Tests/Test31 OR valgrind -q --tool=helgrind --suppressions=Tests/Valgrind-Helgrind-Common.supp Builds/valgrind-debug-SSLPurify-NoBlockAlloc/Tests/Test31
seems to work, I think actual issue is either bug in glibc runtime or more likely just the valgrind checks in that version of OS.
==23843== Thread #1 is the program's root thread
This happens on about 20% of helgrind runs.
For now - just suppress this warning, since it seems likely an issue with curl or openssl, and not stroika.
